messages:
oncall-bot: ALERT · High 503 rate observed for /v1/embeddings (embed-service) — incident 2102467890. spike started ~12:03 UTC. paging eng-oncall. graphs: https://metrics.redwood.internal/graph?i=2102467890 :rotating_light:
jamal: I'm on it. grabbing logs and checking kvcache metrics. any immediate mitigations in runbook?
elena: seeing a big kv_cache_eviction_rate spike, looks like a prefetch loop causing cache churn when sequence lengths burst. will investigate.
maria: can we scale kvcache quickly? doing:```
kubectl -n prod scale deploy/embed-kvcache --replicas=10
kubectl -n prod set env deploy/embed-service PREFETCH_ENABLED=false\```
maria: scaled and disabled prefetch. monitoring :eyes: 
sre-bot: Autoscaler note: horizontal-pod-autoscaler/embed-kvcache scaled from 4 -> 10 in response to memoryPressure metric.
jamal: logs show a pile of large requests that evict hot keys. fallback routing triggered to model-variant-lowmem for some requests.
elena: mitigation look: (1) disable aggressive prefetching (done), (2) add prefetch concurrency cap, (3) add short-term eviction alert, (4) tune autoscale policies.
alex: customer-impact question — which tenants saw 503s and how many requests?
product-ops: quick summary: AcmeCorp ~1.2k requests failed (mostly spikes), BetaApps ~480, EduAI ~210. Support notified and we queued templated comms. no reported outages from dashboard but increased errors.
jamal: error rate now dropping to baseline after scale and pref changes. can confirm 503s falling. reverting fallback routing for production traffic.
ops-coach: good containment. let's capture for PM/postmortem. propose owner jamal to lead postmortem doc + retro.
elena: root-cause hypothesis: prefetch strategy + bursty sequences -> cache eviction storm -> increased miss + backend pressure -> 503s. preventing pattern: backpressure on prefetch + circuit breaker when eviction_rate > threshold.
jamal: creating postmortem doc and scheduling a review. proposed times: tomorrow 10:00 PT or 16:00 PT. action items initial list (assignments tentative):
  - limit prefetch concurrency & add circuit breaker (elena)
  - tune embed-kvcache autoscaler thresholds and pod resources (maria)
  - add eviction_rate alert & dashboard (alex)
  - update runbook with this scenario and mitigation steps (ops-coach)
  - customer impact summary & comms follow-up (product-ops)

jamal: doc created: https://docs.internal/postmortems/2102467890-embed-kvcache-storm (will add timeline + logs)
product-ops: support has sent draft comms to AcmeCorp + BetaApps, will share final here for review. :thumbsup:
ops-coach: I'll own runbook update. also propose a brown-bag for org: "Preventing cache storms & safe prefetch patterns" — suggested next Wed 11:00. presenters: @elena + @jamal.
alex: +1 for brown-bag. please record and drop slides in infra-learning.
jamal: allocating tasks into tracker board: https://go/board/12345 — assigning owners and due dates (48-72h for urgent fixes).
sre-bot: INCIDENT 2102467890 status change -> RESOLVED at 12:15 UTC. duration ~12m. followups scheduled.
maria: will follow up with autoscaler tuning PR today.
elena: I'll draft the prefetch guard PR and link to postmortem.
ops-coach: brown-bag invite created and calendar updated. adding retro notes and action tracker.
product-ops: will attach customer comms to the postmortem doc and ping support for any follow-ups.
jamal: thanks all — great quick containment. we'll run the postmortem tomorrow and use the brown-bag to share prevention patterns across infra and product teams.
ops-coach: leaving checklist here for the retro: add timeline, include raw logs + kvcache eviction chart, record decisions, mark followups with owners + due dates.
oncall-bot: (automated) Incident 2102467890 closed. follow-ups and doc: https://docs.internal/postmortems/2102467890-embed-kvcache-storm.
